subject: Cloud Channel Listing: Marketplace RFI (ops / billing / security evidence)
messages:
From: Emma Liang <emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orbitmarketplace.com, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: 2028-09-12T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace RFI: listing controls + billing flow clarifications

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick intro this morning. Orbit Marketplace is preparing the final vendor pack for our Q4 listing window and we need a short RFI from Redwood covering:

1) Operational controls for catalog SKU / entitlement mapping (how your product is represented across AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces)
2) Billing flow and metering (how metered usage is reported, invoice cadence, passthrough for cloud fees)
3) Security evidence we require for listing (SOC2 scope, tenant isolation, encryption at rest/in transit)
4) Fulfillment and support SLAs once customers purchase via marketplace

We'd appreciate a completed questionnaire and supporting docs by EOD Thursday (2028-09-14). If there's an internal contact who owns partner billing or legal signoff, pls loop them in.

Attachments: marketplace-rfi-template-v3.docx (we will re-send in the portal)

Best,
Emma Liang
Vendor Onboarding — Orbit Marketplace
emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com

--
Oracle Partners: Please note Orbit requires completed metering tables per AWS metering spec (link in portal).

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liang <emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-12T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace RFI: listing controls + billing flow clarifications

Emma —

Thanks for the details and timeline. We're on it. I'll coordinate internal owners: Karthik (partner integrations) will take ops/fulfillment questions; Vanessa (billing & finance) will handle the metering/invoicing specifics.

Quick notes so you know what to expect in the deliverable:
- We'll return a completed questionnaire plus a short technical annex describing SKU mapping patterns (hosted API vs. dedicated instances vs. private deployments)
- We'll include a metering worksheet mapping our token/embedding units to common marketplace metering dimensions and expected reporting cadence
- Security evidence bundle will include SOC 2 II summary, tenant isolation description, and KMS integration notes.

If Orbit has any strict constraints on commercial terms (e.g., mandatory passthrough of certain cloud fees or fixed invoice cadence), flag them now so Vanessa can note exceptions.

I'll deliver an initial draft by tomorrow (EOD 9/13) for your review.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-13T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace RFI: ops controls and fulfillment mapping (redwood answers)

Emma / Marcus —

Please find attached our completed questionnaire and three companion files: Redwood_RFI_Answers_20280913.pdf (completed Qs), SOC2-and-Infra-Controls-summary.pdf, pricing-sku-mapping.xlsx (the SKU sheet includes examples for AWS Metering, Azure Marketplace metering, and GCP subscription models). Highlights below:

- Catalog / SKU mapping: We expose discrete SKUs for Hosted-API (per-token metering), Dedicated (monthly subscription SKU + overage meter), and Private (license + managed services SKU). SKU naming convention and entitlement tagging are in the attached spreadsheet. We can emit usage records to Orbit's reporting endpoint or integrate with AWS metering reports depending on the marketplace.

- Metering and billing flow: Our default is monthly invoice, net-30, with usage-reporting delivered daily to the marketplace fulfillment endpoint. For the AWS SaaS Metering model we provide both seller-reported usage and optional Marketplace billing passthrough. We note two exceptions in the sheet where marketplace-enforced fee passthroughs could affect net rates — see rows 18-22.

- Security / compliance: SOC 2 Type II (covering infra and change mgmt) is within scope for marketplace listing. Tenant isolation is detailed: separation by VPC and logical tenancy for hosted customers; Dedicated provides tenant-dedicated GPU pools; Private supports on-prem or VPC-locked control planes. KMS integrations with customer-provided keys are supported.

- Fulfillment & SLAs: Standard 24/7 support for production-tier purchasers, 99.9% uptime SLA on Dedicated SKUs, and documented rollback/fallback paths if a model or region becomes unavailable. Onboarding typically takes 2-4 weeks (listed in the sheet).

If you want, we can prepare a one-pager that maps Orbit's marketplace entitlements to our SKU IDs for faster onboarding in your portal.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_RFI_Answers_20280913.pdf; SOC2-and-Infra-Controls-summary.pdf; pricing-sku-mapping.xlsx

From: procurement@orbitmarketplace.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: 2028-09-14T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Cloud Channel Listing: follow-up on billing exceptions and passthroughs

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifying items before we mark the vendor pack complete:

1) In your metering sheet rows 18-22 you note two exceptions for marketplace-enforced passthrough fees. Procurement needs an explicit statement on whether Redwood can accept passthrough of marketplace transaction fees (e.g., 3% listing fee) or if Redwood requires absorbing those fees and adjusting list prices.

2) Orbit requires proof of invoice delivery and a sample S3 report schema (or equivalent) showing how usage is delivered to the marketplace daily. Can you provide a sample payload?

3) On SLAs: Orbit policy requires escalations be routed to a named person with phone and backup email for any 8+ hour outage on a Dedicated SKU. Please provide a primary on-call contact and backup (personal contact info is okay for the onboarding packet).

Can you turn these around by EOD Friday (2028-09-15)?

Procurement Team
Orbit Marketplace
procurement@orbitmarketplace.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: procurement@orbitmarketplace.com, emma.liang@orbitmarketplace.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-15T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Channel Listing: follow-up on billing exceptions and passthroughs

Hi —

Appreciate the list. Short answers and pointers below; attached is a sample daily usage payload schema (S3-report-sample.json) and a redlined statement about fee passthrough.

1) Marketplace fee passthrough: Redwood can support either model — seller-absorbed fees or buyer-facing passthrough — but contractual language must be explicit. For Orbit's default of passthrough where marketplace deducts a listing fee from customer payments, Redwood can accept passthrough on a per-deal basis. We note two scenarios where passthrough is not compatible: (a) Reserved Dedicated capacity contracts where customer pre-pays discounted commit (we require fees to be reconciled off-invoice), and (b) Private on-prem deployments where no marketplace billing channel exists. See attached redline (pricing-sku-mapping.xlsx tab: passthrough-notes).

2) Sample payload: attached S3-report-sample.json contains the daily usage record layout. Fields include: customer_id, sku_id, usage_units, usage_timestamp, region, meter_dimensions, and signature. We can deliver via S3 drop, HTTPS webhook, or the AWS marketplace usage API.

3) SLA escalation contacts: Primary on-call for marketplace fulfillment: Priyom Das, Senior Ops Manager — +1 650-555-0199, priyom_das@redwood.ai. Backup: Marcus Lin, +1 415-555-0183. We will also supply a PagerDuty integration during onboarding.

Next steps: if Orbit is happy with the sample payload and passthrough note, we'll prepare the final evidence pack and sign the vendor agreement.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Billing & Marketplace Economics — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: S3-report-sample.json; pricing-sku-mapping.xlsx (redlined)
